name: Apache DataFusion Comet
title: docs: document C2R cost for wide/nested schemas in tuning guide
description: In Apache DataFusion Comet (an Apache Spark native accelerator built on DataFusion and Arrow), users running wide or deeply nested schemas experienced major performance regressions during columnar-to-row (C2R) transitions without clear documentation on tuning stage-revert thresholds.

name: Google TensorFlow Core
title: Avoid oneDNN abort for out-of-range convolution attributes
description: When performing oneDNN layout rewriting passes in TensorFlow's C++ kernel engine, out-of-range 64-bit convolution attributes caused process-abort crashes instead of returning clean error status codes.

name: AWS Powertools for AWS Lambda Python
title: fix(event_handler): omit Content-Type header from OpenAPI
description: When generating OpenAPI response schemas for Lambda API Gateway handlers, explicit Content-Type headers were included under response header definitions, violating RFC 7231 / OpenAPI v3 spec compliance (which mandates media types belong under content keys).

name: Twenty Open-Source CRM
title: fix: preserve morph-related records when merging people
description: Merging duplicate people records in Twenty CRM caused silent data loss of morph-related records (tasks, activities, notes) linked to the superseded contact instead of reparenting them to the retained record.

name: CERN TIGRE Medical Tomography Toolbox
title: Fix Varian loader direction and XIM parsing
description: Varian cone-beam CT loaders produced inverted 3D volume reconstructions due to unhandled gantry rotation directions and improper pixel offset padding in XIM raw image files.

name: Neovim Editor Core
title: fix(ui2): retain substitute confirmation highlight with nohlsearch
description: In Neovim's modernized UI2 grid rendering subsystem, running search-and-replace (:s/.../.../c) with :set nohlsearch disabled the visual match confirmation highlight, leaving users unable to see which token was being replaced.

name: Official Node Redis Client
title: fix(sentinel): cap post-connect rediscovery retries
description: When connecting to Redis Sentinel clusters during network partitions, post-connect rediscovery retries looped infinitely, exhausting client connection sockets and memory without triggering failover error handlers.

name: PyTorch Core Deep Learning Framework
title: [BE] Fix B018 warnings in symmetric-memory Triton hooks
description: Useless expression statements in Triton hook registrations triggered Flake8 B018 lint failures, polluting PyTorch's distributed build and CI pipelines.

name: rclone Cloud Storage Synchronization
title: dropbox: propagate caller contexts to SDK requests
description: The Dropbox backend in rclone did not propagate caller context.Context to underlying SDK HTTP requests, causing aborted or timed-out transfers to continue executing in the background and wasting network bandwidth.

name: Node Version Manager
title: [Fix] nvm_alias: unset zsh's extendedglob while reading an alias file
description: Fixes #3885. In Zsh environments where extendedglob was enabled, nvm_alias encountered pattern-matching and syntax evaluation failures while reading alias configuration files, corrupting default alias resolution and node version initialization.

name: MUI Material-UI Ecosystem
title: [docs][autocomplete] Clarify how to render custom start and end adornments
description: Material-UI Autocomplete documentation lacked clear guidance on injecting custom start and end input adornments without overwriting built-in clear and dropdown icons.

name: IBM / DS3 Docling Document Processing
title: fix: skip image enrichment without pages
description: When parsing pageless or plain-text documents through Docling's multimodal document extraction pipeline, image enrichment routines attempted to access page metadata, triggering IndexError exceptions.

name: Rust-Native pnpm Engine
title: fix(resolving-git-resolver): read git package names during resolution
description: In pnpm's next-generation Rust engine (pacquet), resolving Git-hosted package dependencies without explicit manifest names caused resolution failures.

name: Rust-Native pnpm Engine
title: fix(lockfile): compare equivalent git specifiers
description: Equivalent Git specifiers with trailing slashes or commit hashes were treated as distinct, causing unnecessary lockfile thrashing and redundant re-installations.

name: Vite Build Tool
title: fix(build): map CSS chunks in chunk import maps (fix #22946)
description: In Vite production builds, CSS chunks associated with dynamically imported JavaScript modules were omitted from chunk import maps, causing broken stylesheet preloading in micro-frontend architectures.

name: Cloudflare Workers SDK
title: [local-explorer-ui] Fix worker selector scrolling
description: In the Cloudflare Local Explorer UI, the worker selector list was not vertically scrollable, clipping list options when developers worked with large numbers of local workers (exceeding the 9-worker boundary).

name: PostHog Analytics Engine
title: feat(cli): configure sourcemap upload concurrency
description: PostHog CLI sourcemap uploads utilized a hardcoded, global Rayon thread pool restricted to 10 threads. Large frontend build pipelines were unable to configure or throttle upload concurrency to match network or system capabilities.

name: Deepset Haystack AI Framework
title: fix: support quantization ranges for int8/uint8 sentence-transformers…
description: The SentenceTransformersTextEmbedder returned degenerate, meaningless embeddings (e.g., all-zero vectors) and triggered downstream divide-by-zero errors when using precision="int8" or "uint8" for single-text queries. This occurred because scalar-quantization ranges were calculated dynamically on a per-batch basis, collapsing to a single value (min == max) for single texts.

name: Apache DataFusion Ballista Distributed Query Engine
title: feat(scheduler): document REST API with OpenAPI and serve /api/openapi.json
description: Apache DataFusion Ballista's distributed query scheduler lacked machine-readable OpenAPI documentation, complicating client SDK integration, automated cluster deployment, and monitoring tooling.

name: Astral Ruff Python Linter Core
title: [ruff] Avoid false positive when pytest.raises is used in a with statement (RUF061)
description: Closes #28146. In Ruff's Rust linter, rule RUF061 checks for deprecated callable syntax in pytest exception assertions. When pytest.raises(...), pytest.warns(...), or pytest.deprecated_call(...) was already used as a context expression in a with (or async with) statement, passing additional positional arguments (such as with pytest.raises(ValueError, "custom message"):) caused find_argument("func", 1) to match the second positional argument as the deprecated callable parameter, triggering false-positive violations on valid context-manager syntax.

name: Hermes Agent AI Framework
title: fix(dashboard): refresh chat session switcher / fix(dashboard): live-refresh the ChatSessionList switcher
description: In the Hermes Agent web dashboard, ChatSessionList loaded session history only once on component mount, profile change, or manual refresh button click. When users initiated new chats or ended sessions from the terminal CLI or concurrent browser tabs, the switcher showed stale snapshots until a manual page reload.

name: Hugging Face Safetensors
title: fix(numpy): reject non-C-contiguous arrays
description: safetensors.numpy.save serialized Fortran-contiguous and strided arrays using raw memory as C-order data, silently corrupting tensor data upon reload.

name: Graphify Knowledge Graph Engine
title: fix(llm): probe Windows Claude CLI candidates before spawning
description: On Windows, stale npm shims on PATH shadowed native Claude CLI binaries, causing LLM extraction subprocess calls to fail.

name: Graphify Knowledge Graph Engine
title: fix(cli): preserve graph artifacts when community labeling fails
description: When LLM community labeling batches failed, Graphify defaulted to placeholder labels while overwriting graph artifacts with exit code 0.

name: Google TensorFlow Core
title: Fix negative inter-op count in compute pool
description: Passing negative inter_op_parallelism_threads values (such as -1) to process-wide compute pools caused thread pool creation errors.

name: Google TensorFlow Core
title: Avoid abort on invalid quantized pool attributes
description: Process aborted when oneDNN layout passes failed to create replacements for invalid quantized pooling ksize and strides.
sourceStatus: Open / Active (In deep architectural review with reviewer dmiltr3)

name: Electron Framework Core
title: fix: support partial BaseWindow bounds
description: Calling BaseWindow.setBounds() with partial bounds failed to honor the documented Partial<Rectangle> contract because partial bounds normalization lived in BrowserWindow.
sourceStatus: Approved by 3 Core Maintainers (MarshallOfSound Lead, codebytere Chair, VerteDinde Core Maintainer)

name: AWS Lambda Rust Runtime
title: Fix SNS timestamp serialization to preserve millisecond precision
description: Chrono omitted fractional seconds when serializing whole-second DateTime<Utc> timestamps (e.g. 2025-01-01T12:34:56Z vs .000Z), breaking SNS string-to-sign generation and causing SNS signature verification failures in Rust Lambda functions.

name: PyTorch Core Deep Learning Framework
title: Fix pixel_shuffle validation in compile paths
description: Python decompositions and meta implementations of pixel_shuffle calculated squared upscale factors without validating inputs against eager-mode checks, leading to invalid shape arithmetic crashes in torch.compile and FakeTensor execution paths.

name: PyTorch Core Deep Learning Framework
title: Update local linting guidance
description: Contributor documentation for local Python and C++ linting contained outdated setup steps and missing pre-commit hook flags.

name: Apple Core ML Tools
title: fix(mil): reject symbolic classifier probability shapes
description: CoreML's MIL compiler allowed symbolic probability tensor shapes for classifier models, causing runtime compilation crashes on Apple Silicon Neural Engines.

name: Ansible Automation
title: Add ansible-galaxy role download
description: ansible-galaxy CLI provided role installation but lacked a direct download command for archiving role tarballs without running local installation logic.

name: Vercel Next.js
title: fix(app-router): preserve middleware rewrite query parameters in App Route request.nextUrl
description: In Next.js App Router, when middleware performs a rewrite that appends query parameters, request.nextUrl inside Route Handlers lost the middleware-added search parameters.

name: Hermes Agent
title: fix(tui): complete local slash commands
description: TUI auto-completion for slash commands in Hermes Agent dropped local commands.

name: Kubernetes Container Orchestration
title: kubelet: skip zero-valued device requests
description: Kubelet's Device Manager attempted to allocate zero-valued device requests (e.g., requests: nvidia.com/gpu: 0) through the device-plugin allocation pipeline. When a node had registered device plugins with zero healthy devices, this unnecessary allocation call caused container admission to fail and pods to crash.

name: Storybook Ecosystem
title: Angular: Preserve Signal Queries When Applying Story Props
description: Storybook's Angular wrapper overwrote native framework-owned Signal Query properties when applying component mock props, causing runtime UI failures in Angular components using modern signal APIs (e.g., contentChildren()).

name: Nx Monorepo Toolkit
title: fix(webpack): migrate to minimizer-webpack-plugin
description: @nx/webpack relied on the deprecated css-minimizer-webpack-plugin package for production CSS optimization.
sourceStatus: Open / Active (Under active maintainer review with AgentEnder)

name: Pytest Test Framework
title: Fix custom TOML config files passed with -c
description: Passing a custom TOML configuration file via pytest -c caused the system to look for options in [tool.pytest] instead of the documented [pytest] root table, which is only meant for pyproject.toml files.

name: Traceroot AI
title: fix(ui): distinguish fallback field glyph
description: Unmapped filter and dashboard fields shared identical icon glyphs with model fields, causing UI ambiguity.
sourceStatus: Approved by Reviewer (Collaborator ka1kqi approved after production UI component screenshot verification)

name: Deno Runtime Core
title: fix(ext/node): close accepted idle HTTP sockets
description: In Deno's Node.js compatibility layer (node:http), accepted idle HTTP sockets that had not begun receiving an HTTP request remained open when server.close() was called, leaking open sockets and delaying server shutdown (Issue #36513).
sourceStatus: Closed in favor of maintainer follow-up ([#36749](https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/36749)) with full diagnosis endorsement.

name: Delta Lake Rust Core
title: fix(core): preserve nested schema overrides in parquet read schema
description: When DeltaScanConfig specified narrowed nested struct fields, physical schema conversions widened projections to all sibling fields, preventing DataFusion from performing nested leaf pruning during Parquet scans.
sourceStatus: Closed after complete technical review iteration with maintainers.
